verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator's only multi-item operations are moving codes in bulk. You can transfer codes to a new device via QR code, all codes sync automatically when you sign in, and a community user reports exporting all saved codes into one QR code. Editing, deleting and reordering are documented as per-code gestures (swipe or touch-and-hold on a single code), and a community user notes there is no simple text or file export. missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/organize actions, file-based or scriptable bulk export/import, any API or automation surface for AI-native workflows.
